title: Feedback Loop Cycle
description: The four stages that keep survey responses from disappearing into an unread inbox -- and why the last one is the load-bearing stage.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: The learner explains what happens at each stage of a closed feedback loop, and why skipping the last stage undermines the whole cycle.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin four-stage cycle with an explicit return arrow
pedagogical.assessment: Ask what happens to next term's response rate if the club never reports back.
